title: Bounded genus produces a model with rational singularities
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Suppose reduction to rational singularities is possible for $R$ [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]. Then there is a finite tower $X_n\to\cdots\to X_0=\operatorname{Spec}R$ of normalized blowups at closed points above the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. A normalized blowup means the blowup at the reduced closed point followed by normalization in its function field [def-nagata-global-blowup], [def-sc-normalization]. All the schemes $X_i$ are integral and normal, the normalizations in this tower are finite, and the composite $X_n\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is proper and induces an isomorphism of function fields [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-sc-function-field]. At every closed point $x\in X_n$ for which $\dim\mathcal O_{X_n,x}=2$, the local ring $\mathcal O_{X_n,x}$ defines a rational singularity. Length zero is allowed.
